chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Instruct your dying to say: There is no god but Allah, for whoever's last words are: There is no god but Allah, shall enter Paradise."

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: The declaration of tawhid: there is no god but Allah
key_terms.لَقِّنُوا: Prompt or instruct someone to recite
key_terms.مَوْتَاكُمْ: Your dying ones or those near death

ai.seo_question: What should be recited to a dying person in Islam, and what is the virtue of ending with "La ilaha illa Allah"?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to prompt the dying person with the shahadah of tawhid. It emphasizes the salvific significance of ending one's life with the testimony "There is no god but Allah," linking it to entry into Paradise.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.345 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Instruct your dying to say 'There is no god but Allah (swt),' for whoever's last words are 'There is no god but Allah (swt)' will enter Paradise."
